The '''Yminis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

It contained eighty-seven inhabited worlds that were represented by a [[Forshul/Legends|Forshuliri]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the time of the [[Caamas Document]] crisis.<ref name="SotP" />
